svg.title: Learning layers that stay useful
svg.desc: Read and predict, change a rule, connect parts, verify failures, then release a bounded feature. Higher layers keep the skills beneath them.

g.text: Move up without losing the foundations
Start at the bottom. Earlier skills remain useful at every layer.
Explain the checks, the limits, and the recovery plan.
Show what happens when an assumption is wrong.
Follow an input across functions and files.
Make a small manual edit and inspect its effect.
Understand what a short function returns.
AI may assist at every layer. It does not replace practising the layer.
